title: Textile Industry
definition: The textile industry is a labor-intensive manufacturing sector encompassing the entire value chain from fiber production and spinning to weaving, dyeing, and garment manufacturing.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy & Manufacturing Sector) and Geography Optional, focusing on location factors, employment generation, and export competitiveness.
learningOutcomes: Understand Weberian and modern locational factors of the textile industry.
Analyze the structural shift from the decentralized handloom/powerloom sector to organized mills.
Evaluate government schemes like PM MITRA and Tech Textiles.
